shortDescription: Information module for Transit Network Health Summaries Id Trend Analytics

options.name: attribute
options.description: Attribute query parameter. The interested fields in the request. For valid attributes, verify the documentation.

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. End time to which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The unique transit network id, Ex "1551156a-bc97-3c63-aeda-8a6d3765b5b9".

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Maximum number of records to return.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Specifies the starting point within all records returned by the API. It's one based offset. The starting value is 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. The sort order of the field ascending or descending.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Start time from which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

options.name: trendInterval
options.description: TrendInterval query parameter. The time window to aggregate the metrics. Interval can be 5 minutes or 10 minutes or 1 hour or 1 day or 7 days.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
